class_name: 範囲-範囲-ニワタッテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Presents a whole period or area as one unbroken span within which a state holds: 一年を通じて雨が多い, 全線を通じて速度規制がかかる. Its sibling lane takes a person, medium, or activity and means via, through (報道を通じて, 交流を通じて). にわたって instead measures how far a single event extends, so a week of daily meetings is 一週間にわたって, while 一週間を通じて says a state stayed steady across the week.

examples.ruby: この地域[ちいき]は一年[いちねん]を通[つう]じて湿気[しっけ]が多[おお]い。
examples.english: This area is humid all year round.

examples.ruby: 祖父[そふ]は生涯[しょうがい]を通[つう]じて絵[え]を描[か]き続[つづ]けた。
examples.english: My grandfather went on painting his whole life long.

examples.ruby: 四季[しき]を通[つう]じて水温[すいおん]がほとんど変[か]わらない泉[いずみ]だ。
examples.english: It's a spring whose water stays at nearly the same temperature through all four seasons.

patterns.usage_note: Marks the extent an event covers, which can be time, territory, or a count of items, so it usually pairs with an explicit measure: 一週間にわたって, 全域にわたって, 五十項目にわたって. Where を通じて says a state held uninterrupted through a period, にわたって stresses the breadth of what happened. The usual adnominal is にわたる (三日にわたる交渉); にわたっての is the less frequent option.

examples.ruby: 妹[いもうと]の熱[ねつ]は一週間[いっしゅうかん]にわたって下[さ]がらなかった。
examples.english: My little sister's fever refused to break for a whole week.

examples.ruby: 停電[ていでん]の影響[えいきょう]は市内[しない]全域[ぜんいき]にわたった。
examples.english: The blackout's effects spread across the entire city.

examples.ruby: 調査[ちょうさ]は五十[ごじゅう]項目[こうもく]にわたって行[おこな]われた。
examples.english: The survey covered fifty separate items.
